description: llama.cpp inference metrics + AMD GPU hardware stats + host & container resources (genai_stack). Use the GPU variable to switch/compare eGPU (RX 7900 XTX) and iGPU (Radeon 780M) — both the Inference and Hardware rows repeat per selected GPU. Queries use 'llamacpp:' metric prefix — if panels show no data, OTel may have normalized colons to underscores; replace ':' with '_' in each query. Host/container metrics use OTel naming: system_cpu_load_average_*, system_memory_usage_bytes, container_cpu_utilization_ratio, container_memory_usage_total_bytes.
title: llama-cpp + AMD GPU (eGPU/iGPU)

panels.description: Instantaneous prompt throughput reported by the llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds gauge. Filtered to periods when requests_processing > 0 so the stat shows 'idle' when no prompt is being processed.
panels.title: Prompt Throughput

panels.description: Instantaneous generation throughput reported by the llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds gauge. Filtered to periods when requests_processing > 0 so the stat shows 'idle' when no tokens are being generated.
panels.title: Generation Throughput

panels.description: Requests currently being processed. Metric: llamacpp:requests_processing
panels.title: Active Requests

panels.description: Requests waiting (deferred / queued). Metric: llamacpp:requests_deferred
panels.title: Queued Requests

panels.description: Average busy slots per llama_decode() call — indicates parallelism utilisation. Metric: llamacpp:n_busy_slots_per_decode
panels.title: Busy Slots / Decode

panels.description: llama_decode() calls per second (5 min rate). Metric: llamacpp:n_decode_total
panels.title: Decode Rate

panels.description: Instantaneous prompt and generation token throughput over time. Uses the llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds and llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds gauges, filtered to periods when requests_processing > 0 so the line disappears (no stale value) when inference is idle.
panels.title: Token Throughput

panels.description: Active and queued requests over time, plus llama_decode() call rate.
panels.title: Requests & Decode Activity

panels.description: Long-term/cumulative token throughput averaged over a 2-minute rolling window (derived from counters). This under-reports instantaneous burst throughput because it includes idle time since the model loaded; use the 'Token Throughput' panel for the instantaneous gauge-based view. Prompt rate = rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total[2m]). Gen rate = rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total[2m]).
panels.title: Token Counter Rates (2 min cumulative)

panels.description: Instantaneous time spent per token. Prompt ms/token = 1000 / llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds. Generation ms/token = 1000 / llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds. Filtered to periods when requests_processing > 0 so the line disappears when inference is idle.
panels.title: Time per Token

panels.description: GPU engine utilisation (0–100 %). Metric: amdgpu_gpu_busy_percent{gpu=~"$gpu"}
panels.title: GPU Busy

panels.description: VRAM utilisation as a percentage. Metric: (amdgpu_vram_used_bytes + amdgpu_gtt_used_bytes) / amdgpu_vram_total_bytes * 100. GTT is included because the iGPU (UMA/APU, no dedicated VRAM) places most allocations in the GTT domain rather than the VRAM domain — vram_used alone reads ~0% on the iGPU even under heavy load, while the dGPU's gtt_used is normally negligible so this doesn't affect it.
panels.title: VRAM Usage

panels.description: Average GPU power draw in watts. Metric: amdgpu_power_watts{gpu=~"$gpu"}
panels.title: GPU Power

panels.description: Edge (die) temperature in °C. Metric: amdgpu_temperature_celsius{gpu=~"$gpu",sensor="edge"}
panels.title: Temp · Edge

panels.description: Junction (hotspot) temperature in °C. Metric: amdgpu_temperature_celsius{gpu=~"$gpu",sensor="junction"}
panels.title: Temp · Junction

panels.description: HBM/GDDR memory temperature in °C. Metric: amdgpu_temperature_celsius{gpu=~"$gpu",sensor="mem"}
panels.title: Temp · Mem

panels.description: GPU fan speed in RPM. Metric: amdgpu_fan_rpm{gpu=~"$gpu"}
panels.title: Fan Speed

panels.description: GPU engine utilisation % over time with threshold bands. Also overlays decode call rate from llama-$gpu on the right axis for correlation.
panels.title: GPU Utilisation

panels.description: VRAM used, VRAM total capacity, and GTT (system RAM used as overflow) over time.
panels.title: VRAM & GTT Usage

panels.description: All three temperature sensors over time: edge (die surface), junction (hotspot), and memory.
panels.title: GPU Temperatures

panels.description: GPU average power draw in watts. Metric: amdgpu_power_watts{gpu=~"$gpu"}
panels.title: GPU Power Draw

panels.description: GPU core (GFX) and memory clocks in Hz (auto-scaled to MHz/GHz). Metrics: amdgpu_core_clock_hz, amdgpu_memory_clock_hz
panels.title: GPU Clocks

panels.description: Largest prompt context ever seen since the server started (high-water mark). Monotonically increasing — each step up marks a longer conversation. Useful for spotting context pressure and proximity to the model's configured -c limit. Metric: llamacpp:n_tokens_max_total
panels.title: Context High-Water Mark

panels.description: Host system CPU load averages (1 / 5 / 15 min). Sourced from OTel host_metrics scraper. Metrics: system_cpu_load_average_1m, system_cpu_load_average_5m, system_cpu_load_average_15m. A sustained 1-min spike while GPU is 100% busy indicates CPU-side decoding or tokenisation bottleneck.
panels.title: Host CPU Load Average

panels.description: Host system memory breakdown by state. Stacked area: used + cached + free adds up to total installed RAM. Sourced from OTel host_metrics scraper. Metric: system_memory_usage_bytes{state="used|cached|free"}.
panels.title: Host Memory

panels.description: Per-container CPU utilisation (%). Sourced from OTel docker_stats receiver. Metric: container_cpu_utilization_ratio × 100. Label: container_name. Shows all running stack services (llama, open-webui, otel-collector, etc.).
panels.title: Container CPU Utilisation

panels.description: Per-container memory usage in bytes. Sourced from OTel docker_stats receiver. Metric: container_memory_usage_total_bytes. Label: container_name. Useful for catching memory leaks and spotting which service is consuming the most host RAM.
panels.title: Container Memory Usage

panels.description: Generation throughput normalized by active memory usage (VRAM + GTT — the iGPU places most allocations in GTT since it has no dedicated VRAM domain). Higher = better tokens-per-GB efficiency. Uses the instantaneous throughput gauge, filtered to periods when requests_processing > 0. Metric: llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds / (sum(amdgpu_vram_used_bytes{gpu=~"$gpu"} + amdgpu_gtt_used_bytes{gpu=~"$gpu"}) / 1GiB)
panels.title: Generation Efficiency (tok/s per GB VRAM)

targets.expr: (llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds{server=~"$gpu",model=~"$model"} and on(server, model) (llamacpp:requests_processing{server=~"$gpu",model=~"$model"} > 0)) / on() group_left() (sum(amdgpu_vram_used_bytes{gpu=~"$gpu"} + amdgpu_gtt_used_bytes{gpu=~"$gpu"}) / 1073741824)
